Model trained on volcano-tectonic and long-period earthquakes with a learning rate of 0.001.
Threshold selected for optimal F1 score on the validation set. Depending on the target region, the thresholds might need to be adjusted.
When using this model, please reference
Yiyuan Zhong and Yen Joe Tan (2024). Geophysical Research Letters, 51, e2024GL108438. https://doi.org/10.1029/2024GL108438.
